name: Defend the Wall!
author: aallbright
description: This is my personal project for the scripting pathway. Ambition led me to want to create helms deep. Reality checked those ambitions! I burned a lot of time doing research to create this buggy mess. But I love it, warts and all. To anyone that isn't me actually playing this, I'm sorry. There are bugs but I have to call it quits. Time. Time is so limited...
